body:
## What to build

Refuse a non-missing scalar Margin label for a local grouping dimension with more than two array dimensions, with an actionable Package condition identifying the dimension and offering typed missing labels or separate scalar columns. Apply the same schema-based decision to populated and empty inputs.

At main snapshot `b6f9faba946521aeb92fcf2c5655a2c3bf608ec8`, a two-row input carrying a 2-by-2-by-2 array dimension is groupable by ordinary dplyr and expands successfully with a typed-missing label. The default string label instead escapes validation and fails in a generated character conversion: `g must be size 2 or 1, not 8`. The zero-row input with the same schema is accepted and converted to character. Disabling the observed collision check does not resolve the failure.

The existing scalar-label refusal covers local matrices and packed data-frame dimensions, but a higher-dimensional array loses its shape in the prototype path and is missed by the guard. This ticket applies the same avoidable-input diagnostic boundary under ADR 0015; it does not introduce an array display encoding. The completed #688 concerned fixed-key ordering, a different boundary.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Both populated and zero-row higher-dimensional array dimensions receive `marginplyr_error` before generated label conversion when a non-missing string label is requested.
- [ ] The diagnostic names the caller's dimension and gives the typed-missing or separate-column remedy.
- [ ] The two-row typed-missing expansion retains four rows and its 4-by-2-by-2 shape under both missing-label spellings.
- [ ] Arrays used only as fixed keys continue to require no Margin label, and existing matrix and packed-column behavior is preserved.
- [ ] Public regression coverage distinguishes the Package condition from unchanged external errors in caller expressions.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

comments.body:
The shared validation failure also reproduces in both nesting interfaces with a two-row 3D array dimension and the default label: generated conversion raises a size-8 versus size-2 mutate error. A typed-missing label succeeds and returns three nested groups. This confirms the nesting impact of the existing issue.

[Independent reproduction and controls](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/2c86147fddea4a825860ee3554c49582d290d63c/investigation/nest-grouping-bug-hunt-2026-10-25.md#f5-scalar-labels-for-higher-dimensional-arrays-escaped-validation).

Evidence and runnable probes are recorded in [the dated investigation](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/4a85bb32185cdb298985a0a65af0554aefc9c0a9/investigation/expand-grouping-bug-hunt-2026-10-25.md#higher-dimensional-array-labels) and PR #840. The note pins the inspected snapshot and distinguishes observed failures from successful controls and excluded leads. No package implementation is included.
